Subject: Laser Cut BOM - 1573 - Kings Road 2.Entire System - SQR-47335

 

Daniel,

 

Thanks for popping in today. It was great to meet you.

 

Below is the Dropbox link of the files that need to be quoted as soon as possible. I've also pasted below the supplier notes.

 

Remember, speed of quote is important, and to only quote for countersink and tapping on folded parts.

https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/j8ur4u2bvq5og6bgukq1b/AL9zApqelo8btSpGRJIl-zI?rlkey=ubc290ol91eibib6qx3tt5tss&st=2vgpm2y4&dl=0

 

 

I have the following supplier notes I pass on to any new supplier just so the expectations can be set:

We dimensionally check EVERY part and EVERY hole - so grouping parts to the correct assembly pack speeds up the QC process and minimises errors. 

The goal is to organise the parts in a way that we can QC swiftly and accurately since wrong or missing parts cause significant issues.

 

1.      Grouping  all items as per Assembly pack numbers is critical. Ideally on separate pallets where this is reasonably economic, then part separation is acceptable. The Assembly Pack is highlighted in BOLD below, as an example within this part number 1406.1002.D.023 (for info only - the first 4 digits are the job number, then assembly number with letter sub assembly group, and the three at the end are part specific no.) 

2.      Labels on every part is required to swiftly identify the parts correctly, and also feedback to you (an image of the label) if we identify an issue. (Our part number on each part is essential - possibly add your works order number too. and qty of the line is also helpful on the label if possible.)

3.      A check sheet of what is on each pallet is handy at recording what has ACTUALLY been put on that pallet. (This can also be very handy for small items where there are few of them and they can fit in a box.)

4.      Other than that double check DP1 parts for brush direction as this has historically been a real hiccup for NCR's.

5.      ONLY TAP AND COUNTERSINK FOLDED PARTS

6.      ALWAYS DETAIL VARIATIONS in the email ad the quotes can be long and information overlooked 

7.      Quotes include : 

a.      PDF's for quoting 

b.     DXF's for Nesting 

c.      stp files for developing the parts if the order is won

d.     an excel BOM which is the source of truth on material type 

 

We hope that you find this information useful and indicates how seriously we take our supply chain.

The size of the pie is currently £200 - £250k pa

Please see the BOM's in the following two links to understand the top and bottom end of our requirements:

Siracusa BOM - Large lift - £15.5k June 2021

Manchester 5B - Platform only - £5.5k April 2022

EU Parlement Lift - Retracting 11 step - July 24 - £16k


Many Thanks,
 
Giles
Purchasing Manager
